$description: Component tokens: what a button, field, card, pill or dialog reads. Each starts as an alias of a semantic token, so nothing moves; a kit or a theme sets them to restyle a component without touching a colour (ADR-0019).

card-line.$description:
A card's edge. --line all but vanishes between a white card and the light
page (1.06:1), so a grid of cards read as one sheet of paper. Light takes
the next step up; dark keeps the hairline, since there a card is lighter
than the page and its fill does the work (§6). Decoration, not a boundary.

card-shadow.$description: Lifts a card off the page in light; dark has no light shadow layer.

control-height.$description:
── Density ──
The height of a button, input or select at each size. `data-density="compact"`
on <html> or any element tightens them for a dense tool screen. Touch
screens keep their 44px targets either way (DESIGN.md §10).

compact.$description: A dense tool screen: one step tighter.
